title: Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Silicon Valley Paving, Inc. – Oakland Technical High School Asphalt Replacement Project – Buildings and Grounds Department
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Silicon Valley Paving, Inc., San Jose, CA, for additional construction services to repair approximately 3,520 square feet of damaged asphalt near the Boy's Gym, including off haul soil, tack-coating the edges of the existing asphalt and pave with ½-inch hot mix asphalt, followed by rolling for compaction to achieve a smooth and even finish for the Oakland Technical High School Asphalt Replacement Project, in the amount of $29,884.00*, increasing the Agreement price not-to-exceed amount from $559,716.00 to $589,599.00. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
____
*A painting contractor damaged the new asphalt while using a boom to paint the exterior of the gym. The painting contractor has agreed to a charge back.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $29,884 to Silicon Valley Paving's Oakland Tech asphalt contract to repair damaged pavement
summary: This change order pays Silicon Valley Paving to repair about 3,520 square feet of asphalt near the boys' gym at Oakland Technical High School. A painting contractor's equipment damaged the new asphalt, and the painting contractor has agreed to a charge back. The contract's maximum price rises from $559,716 to $589,599.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: General Services Agreement – ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. – Central Administration at Cole Campus - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a General Services Agreement by and between the  District and ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc., Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide environmental consulting services, i.e., provide supplemental inspection and sampling of suspect asbestos-containing materials; . provide Abatement Oversight Monitoring and Air Monitoring Services during the abatement of asbestos-containing pipe and boiler insulation at the main building, for the Central Administration at Cole Campus Project, in the lump-sum amount of $50,623.00, with the work scheduled to commence on February 27, 2025, and scheduled to last until June 30, 2025.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays ACC Environmental $50,623 to monitor asbestos removal at the Cole Campus administration building
summary: ACC Environmental Consultants will inspect and sample suspected asbestos-containing materials. It will also oversee the removal and monitor the air while asbestos-containing pipe and boiler insulation is removed from the main building at the Central Administration at Cole Campus. The work is scheduled to run from February 27, 2025 to June 30, 2025.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, Grant Award - State of California - Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) - Oakland Schoolyards Planning Project - Chief Systems and Services Officer
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Grant Award by and between the District and State of California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection Resource Management, Sacramento, CA, extending the term of the Grant Award, from December 6, 2023 through March 30, 2025 to May 31, 2025, of $2,798,074.20, for the purpose of supporting Oakland Living Schoolyards Planning Project, on fifteen campuses, which Project objectives during this planning phase will include increasing the understanding of the schools’ needs to transform them into living schoolyards; engaging the school community in the living school yard design; conducting soils testing and completing a geotechnical report; providing opportunities to work with science teachers to design an outdoor space that supports … curriculum; broadening the awareness of climate change; and preparation for the implementation grant project. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
headline: Extends the state CAL FIRE living schoolyards planning grant at 15 campuses to May 31, 2025
summary: This amendment extends the district's grant from the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) from March 30, 2025 to May 31, 2025. The grant, listed at $2,798,074.20, supports planning to turn 15 campuses into living schoolyards, including community design input, soil testing and a geotechnical report. The text does not state any added money.
vendor_name: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE)
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
